oneLiner: Open hackathon judging: every entry gets a rule-by-rule verdict anyone can verify.
description: Eligibility Judge qualifies public GitHub entries against a frozen, validator-accepted rulebook. GenLayer validators judge one rule per transaction, independently fetch evidence at the submitted commit, and verify the leader's exact quote and file path. Entries passing every rule qualify; there are no scores or rankings. After close and finalized judgments, contract code divides a funded StudioNet GEN pool equally, refunds the integer remainder or an empty qualifying pool, and supports pull claims. Builders get one revision before close. The mobile-first app separates recorded proof from finalized live reads, preserves transaction polling across reloads, and uses native appeals. The repository includes direct tests, source, a tutorial, and a read-only finalized proof verifier. The live four-case demo settled and paid its one-wei pool; finalized receipts are in deploy/proof.json.

howTo.heading: Audit the public ledger
howTo.instruction: Open the site without a wallet. Inspect Entries and the frozen Rulebook. Click a rule chip to see its quote and exact file at the commit.

howTo.heading: Read finalized state
howTo.instruction: Choose Live chain. Inspect the labeled read time and contract link. Accepted transactions remain provisional until finality.

howTo.heading: Inspect settlement
howTo.instruction: Choose Payouts and follow settlement, claim and credited-transfer links. Run npm run verify:proof from the public repo.

howTo.heading: Run a new challenge
howTo.instruction: Connect your StudioNet wallet, create and fund a challenge, validate each rule, then submit a public GitHub commit during its window. Judge rules, settle after finality and close, and claim your share.

expectedOutcome: The seeded demo shows one qualified entry, two disqualified fixture commits, and one missing commit with insufficient evidence. All sixteen judgments finalized; deterministic settlement awarded one wei to the qualifier, whose pull claim produced a credited native transfer. Inspect deploy/proof.json and docs/browser-verification.json for the current verification status before submission.
